title: H4709 (122nd General Assembly): Concealed weapons permits

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2018-01-24; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/4709_20180124.htm (LegiScan doc 1698307))
provenance.note: Introduced text (Jan. 24, 2018). Struck: items (1)-(6), (8), (9): law enforcement/correctional facilities, courthouses, polling places, government meetings, school/college athletic events, daycare, churches, medical facilities. Only the federal-law and posted-sign items remain. Quote joins the surviving items; penalty paragraph for wilful violation of the other items not quoted.

operative_text: Section 1 (Section 23-31-215(M)): "(M) A permit issued pursuant to this section does not authorize a permit holder to carry a concealable weapon into a: (1) place where the carrying of firearms is prohibited by federal law; or (2) place clearly marked with a sign prohibiting the carrying of a concealable weapon on the premises pursuant to Sections 23-31-220 and 23-31-235. Except that a property owner or an agent acting on his behalf, by express written consent, may allow individuals of his choosing to enter onto property regardless of a posted sign to the contrary. A person who violates a provision of this item, whether the violation is wilful or not, only may be charged with a violation of Section 16-11-620 and must not be charged with or penalized for a violation of this subsection."
